Big content update coming your way to steam playtest users!

This update includes 20 new items,

1 Under-side-of-a-Logs-worth of Bug Fixes

I found some large systems that weren't functioning properly, and patched them up, so even somethings you didn't know were broken were fixed 🙂 Hopefully this makes for a much better gameplay experience. One of the main benefactors is toilet paper items. They were not spawning correctly, so it was harder to move up the chain.

notes.title: Settings Update!
notes.notes: Changed the settings menu to have multiple tabs, with a lot of room for expansion (the VFX doesn't have anything yet). Feel free to toggle things to where you want, and if you ahev more settings you'd like, feel free to suggest them here. Binary ones (something either on/off) are much easier to make than more complex ones. I'm still planning on adding a bunch more settings, but if you suggest them I'll try and make them even faster

notes.title: 0.70.0 update Announcing 3 new characters!
notes.notes:
Broom Hilda: Broom Hilda has her sturdy Ushanka, which means they lose 1 less damage from disturbing a dust bunny BUT she also paints all of the walls extreme gray in each office, making each office 2 rows and columns smaller.

Cousteau D'ian: After a life of painting masterpieces, the world of pop art has taken a toll on Cousteau, so he's retired back to his roots of humbling cleaning Offices, while painting them colors. Each quadrant of each office has a unique effect. Green - lose 1 less hp when disturbing a db, Red - lose 1 more life when disturbing a db, Yellow - you're slightly luckier when you sweep a db, and Magenta - starts with tentacles.

Han Demon - Han it a mass of tentacles escaped from what's really going on at Tentateq. It wasn't hired at Tentateq, so it earns no money from cleaning offices, BUT has 2 dust pans, so each time you disturb a DB, you earn $2. Han also has Morphallaxis, which means it regrows it's HP to full after each office.

The main feedback I'm looking for these characters is their concept, theme, and playability. Basically: do they make sense and are fun to play? It will definitely take some time to balance them out and have characters that all are interesting and change the way you play. And right now we're focused on part 2: are these characters interesting mechanically? 

Part 2: Upper Floors!

When you survive a shift, you'll unlock the floor above. Each upper floor adds a new challenge to your shift, up to floor 10. Progress is unique to each character, so feel free to go deep on each worker and see how good they really are at Sweeping. Feel free to post your progress as you climb the floors in ⁠clips-and-highlights  here or on your favorite social medias. I haven't beaten floor 10 on anyone, so you could be the first! Good Luck 🙂

Part 3: lots of bug fixes

You know the deal: something breaks, please post ^_^

notes.title: New Package Layout and Sounds
notes.notes:
Packages have a  lot of new visual features, layout, flow, more items can come from packages, and I added a bunch of different package puzzles to compensate. This area of the game should be way more fleshed out. They will be later improved by having packages with multiple entry points and hazmats, to make for an even more interesting puzzle experience.

I also changed up the sounds a little bit to make them more cohesive with each other. Let me know what you think :) I'm goign to be adding a lot more sounds and satisfying feedback for actions to keep polishing up interactions

notes.title: A Moldy Update
notes.notes:
Reworked Mold's visuals and description. You should no longer see one big mold sprite, it should be on each of the trash bags individually. It will now also show when those tiles are cleaned by removing the mold

Basically every item has been reworded, but none of them have changed functionality. There are a few items that will have some minor functionality changed to go along with the clearer wording, but nothing game-breaking...except....CrossPipe now works with hammers, wrenches, and construction because they have been reworded to "1 column wider, 1 row taller" which has the crosspipe special words in it. Crosspipe's cost will also go up slightly to compensate for this. Lots of other small fixes included in this patch, as always

notes.title: Middle Management Update!
notes.notes:
Introducing a new type of Lobby Room: Middle Management!
These are similar to Offices, except they have a sinister twist (evil laughter). They have a different Lobby Hint and Lobby Symbol to let you know where they're going to be. Also when you're in them, there's a different background to let you know that it's extra sinister (evil laughter #2)

Boss's Offices will also now have a different background to remind you that since they make more money than you, the Bosses are strictly superior in every way. Defeat those capitalist pigs!!!

Added 2 new events exclusive to ACT 1. ACT 1 was just a little too hard and people were having trouble ghetting off the ground, so here's some cool items to get you through.

Added a new system for showing when and which hazmats get unlocked. Be sure to lookout for it as things get harder

notes.title: Pirate Key Update
notes.notes:
YAR! It's pirate key time! Pirate key has been reworked to be significantly easier to trigger, and now has an animate to accompany it. Now it does: "If there are 7 or more DBs in a 13 tile X, reveal all non-Dust Bunny tiles. If not, reveal all tiles and DBs in the X, and lose 7 HP". If you can find the X with at least 7 dust bunnies, congratulations! the office is clean 🙂 Either way, you get a cool animation

More bug fixes, including the elusive "remove multiple DBs at the same time" bug that's been plaguing mop users. 

Balance changes to a lot of unpopular item, either making them more effective or just cheaper 🙂 There will be some terminology/wording changes coming soon, but these won't effect how items function

notes.title: Key Animations

2. Keys now have animations! (mostly). It feels like people are using them a lot, and I thought it'd be cool to have some large, grandiose animations to go with them. Feel free to try out (most) all of the keys to see them and give me feedback. My favorite is the cement key!,
Up next: Pirate Key rework + animation, and more bug fixes

notes.title: Bug Fix update, round 1:
notes.notes:
1. Fixed "save to main menu" button in settings that catastrophically broke the game in many ways. Now it does not break the game :) thanks @agonymouse for the playtest session that helped me understand this bug better. 
2. Fixed/enabled bugs relating to removing multiple dust bunnies at the same time. This error occured because of how I was processing changes in the state of each tile. While fixing this, I also went through the 'floodfill" animation to improve it a ton, since the bug was heavily related to how that code was being processed. So, there's a new floodfill animation AND it works on open tiles, so you can watch it many times in a row :) I changed the algorithm for processing distance during that animation, so now it properly "snakes" around areas. This will hopefully have a super cool visual effect. Thanks again @interlucid for reporting the bug
